flyer.justification: The flyer is punchy, adheres to all formatting constraints including the title word limit, and accurately highlights key themes.

linkedin.justification: Follows all LinkedIn guidelines, avoids banned buzzwords, includes a clear call to action, and uses appropriate hashtags.

instagram.justification: Includes engaging carousel cues, clear emoji-bulleted takeaways, and exactly 10 targeted hashtags.

summary.justification: Structured perfectly according to executive summary guidelines, well under the 400-word limit with actionable points.

newsletter.justification: Features a conversational editorial tone, three distinct bold subheadings, and a concise subject line under 50 characters.

blog.justification: The article is well written with an author bio and comparison table, but failed to use numbered section headings as required.
